_comment: Lead-and-team routing in the fableous-orchestrated mode (.claude/protocols/orchestration.md).
Nothing here acts in freestyle or guided-solo, except the progress object below.
nudge_after: after this many Write/Edit calls by the lead on code (outside .claude/state/,
.claude/tasks/, docs/ and prose files) with no sub-agent dispatched, the post-write hook
hands the lead one advisory reminder to delegate, then counts again. 0 turns it off. It never
blocks and never changes a gate decision.
handoff_test_timeout: seconds each recorded test may run under `checkctl handoff <id> --run`.
A timeout is a FAIL for that test.
progress: the long-run view (tools/progress.py, `statectl progress`, the console's Progress panel).
pulse_seconds: the policy gate (after its decision) and the sub-agent capture lane rewrite
state/heartbeat.json as 'working' once it is older than this, so 'last activity' stays true
through a multi-hour turn. Every mode. 0 turns it off.
report_minutes: in guided-solo and fableous-orchestrated, the post-write hook hands the lead the
compact progress block to post to the user once this many minutes have passed since the last
one. Advisory, main session only, never in freestyle. 0 turns it off.
